title: Destination register of a counter state
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number and let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine. The destination register of a counter state is register $5$ for a state of type $lb$, register $6$ for a state of type $lt$, and register $7$ for every other counter state.
hypotheses_covered: a finite Boolean Turing machine M
